plain: The Model Spec rule that GPT may translate, summarise or reformat text the user pasted in, even text it would not write itself, as long as it adds nothing harmful.
eli5: You can ask the robot to copy your own note neatly, but it won't add new bad parts.
technical: A Root-level carve-out letting GPT translate, paraphrase, summarise, classify, encode, format or proofread restricted or sensitive content the user directly supplied, provided the output draws only on that input; it never reaches the prohibited tier.
